release_note: Midnight local time on Thursday 19 November 2026, in every region, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

editions.name: Standard Edition
editions.contents: The game, digital or code-in-box (no disc). Pre-orders and purchases before 20 Nov 2026 add the Vintage Vice City Pack; digital ones also add a free month of GTA+. Upgrade to Ultimate any time.

editions.name: Ultimate Edition
editions.contents: Digital only. The game plus the Ultimate Edition Upgrade: vehicles, weapons, outfits, businesses and properties that unlock across the story's chapters. Same pre-order bonuses as Standard.

preload.text: PS5: from midnight local time on 10 Nov 2026. Xbox Series X|S: from 12 a.m. GMT on 10 Nov 2026. Code-in-box buyers can pre-load once the code is redeemed.
